source.note: BACKLOG 1611, the claim label. The request is Atlassian's own example's `update.labels` member — [{"add": "triaged"}, {"remove": "blocker"}] — cut to the one operation the claim (add) or the release (remove) sends, with the label replaced by this corpus's claim label and every other example member (fields, historyMetadata, properties, the other update fields) removed. An `update` operation names only the label it adds or removes, so the request never restates — and cannot overwrite — the issue's other labels. The response is the documented 204, 'Returned if the request is successful.', which has no body. The operation requires 'Browse projects and Edit issues project permission for the project that the issue is in'; 400 is documented for, among others, 'the user does not have the necessary permission to edit one or more fields', and 404 for 'the issue is not found or the user does not have permission to view it'.
